verdict.rationale: Sending through an SMTP relay is a fair question for a transactional email service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only HTTP REST sending endpoints (/email, /email/batch, templates, bulk) authenticated with the X-Postmark-Server-Token header. Nothing in it mentions an SMTP relay, SMTP host or port settings, or generated SMTP credentials.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send through a documented SMTP relay with generated credentials when my framework or legacy app can't call the REST API
